question: The diameter of the base of a right circular cone is 60 cm its height is 16 cm. The curved surface area(in cm²) of the cone is:
solution:
**Given:**

The diameter of the base of a right circular cone = 60 cm

The height of a right circular cone = 16 cm

**Formula used:**

The curved surface area of the cone = π × (radius) × (slant height)

(Slant height)² = (radius)² + (height)²

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/16172c5909bd2dbf449f4c35f376a9b53f237df233d0daa82e762852c2fae84d.png] 

**Calculation:**

Let, diameter = D

Radius = R

⇒ R = D/2 = 60/2 = 30 cm

(Slant height)2 = (radius)2 + (height)2

Slant height = sqrt {R² + H²}

Slant height = sqrt {30² + 16² } 

⇒ sqrt { 900 + 256 }

⇒ sqrt { 1156}

⇒ 34

Now, The curved surface area of the cone = π × (radius) × (slant height)

⇒ π × 30 × 34

⇒ 1020 π 

**∴ The curved surface area (in cm2) of the cone is 1020 π **
